summary: 跨 owner 编排执行首片 on BASE d38165a (rebased after PH-327). Adds invoicing/orchestration_services.py that turns a PH-320 reversal/attribution context into named owner-service execution for management-revenue reversal, cash refund/bank return and settlement clearance/reverse-clearance. The service validates invoice/reversal/expected_version, derives a deterministic owner request token from the orchestration token, invokes the owner's named service (reverse_recognition / record_refund / record_bank_return / create_clearance / reverse_clearance), builds the resulting owner ref, and appends it through PH-320 link_invoice_orchestration after attribution validation. It stores an append-only execution receipt in AuditEvent keyed by request_token+digest (receipt is checked before state gates for replay), records executed/link_pending audit, and on owner/link failure leaves no execution receipt/link; the owner action is retried through its own idempotency receipt on retry. It never writes revenue/cash/settlement directly and explicitly returns single_transaction_claim=false. Adds a read-only orchestration snapshot and invoicing page with separate history_read page and business_write execute routes; owner/finance write, auditor read, member denied. No new canonical model/migration/canonical topic/contract schema. Tests cover real cash-refund owner execution + link + audit + snapshot, token replay/no duplicate owner fact and changed-input conflict, failed owner action with no execution/link, role/expected-version rejection, cross-org invoice and mismatched-counterparty attribution rejection, revenue/settlement dispatch via injected named-service fakes, and HTTP GET/POST/invalid/role behavior. verify_integrity has no new PH-370 branch because core verify_integrity is outside the PH-370 allowlist; the read-only snapshot is the in-scope reconciliation surface. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: execute now requires invoicing module enabled at the service layer (not just the page), and orchestration_snapshot now allows only owner/finance/auditor/pm (pm project scope preserved), denying member/unknown roles; regressions cover disabled-module execute and direct member snapshot reads.
